exam_name: ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Human Resources (CIS-HR)
passing_score_scale: Scaled score; the cut score is not publicly disclosed and is not always 70%.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID with full name and photo. Name must match exactly as registered.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or external resources. Closed-book exam. ServiceNow platform access not provided during exam. Proctor monitors via webcam.
renewal_options: Pass a delta maintenance exam after each major ServiceNow release (approximately twice per year). Delta exams are shorter and free for certified candidates.

retake_policy.notes: 7-day waiting period after first failed attempt. Full exam fee required for retake. Certifications must be maintained via delta exams after each major release.

domains.name: Describe and use the ServiceNow HR System Architecture
Configure and Implement ServiceNow Core HR Applications and Employee Center
objectives: HR Service, HR Catalog Items, and Record Producers

domains.name: Configure and Implement HR Journeys
objectives: Describe the basic structure of a Lifecycle Event and a Journey
Explain how to configure a Lifecycle Event and Journey; including Activity sets, trigger conditions, activities, audience, and activity field mappings

domains.name: Describe and Use Platform, Role, and Contextual Security
objectives: Describe how Platform, role, and contextual security are used in ServiceNow
Understand how the Delegated Developer role works
Understand how to configure security options to protect HR data
